engine.label: Engine
engine.waitStarting: Starting the engine: opening the data folder and loading the model…
engine.waitRestarting: The engine stopped unexpectedly and is being restarted
engine.fatalHint: Nothing can be measured until the engine runs. The log folder holds the details.
engine.orphanHint: Another engine is still serving this data folder (left by an app that did not close properly). Try again stops it and starts a new one.
engine.bannerUnresponsive: The engine is not answering its health check. It keeps running; saving may be slow or fail.
engine.bannerArabicStack: The engine's Arabic text stack is missing: engine images and reports cannot be produced.
engine.bannerStubModel: Development engine with the stub model: the frame search detects nothing.
engine.labelsFailed: The engine's labels could not be loaded: codes are shown as they are.

save.blockedHint: Finalized and exported sessions are not edited. Reopen it to change it; its image and report then have to be made again.
save.blockedUnsaved: The session was finalized elsewhere while you edited: your changes stay here but were not saved. Reopen it to save them.
save.offlineHint: Your changes stay here and are sent as soon as the engine answers.
save.errorHint: Your changes are kept; the next change is sent again.

bag.title: Open a recording
bag.intro: Choose a D455 recording (.bag file). The engine reads it; the app only passes its path.
bag.pastePath: Or paste the path of a .bag file
bag.noFoldersHint: Add the folders the camera records into, and their recordings are listed here.
bag.noneFound: No recordings found in the capture folders
bag.truncated: The scan stopped at its limit: not every folder was searched.
bag.foldersDescription: The app lists the .bag recordings it finds in these folders and their subfolders, up to a limit.
bag.findFramesHint: The engine reads the recording and proposes frames where the whole camel is in view with good depth. It runs in the background; you can stop it and keep what it found.
bag.nextHint: Open a recording: the engine reads its summary, then you can search it for the best frames to measure.
bag.scanHint: Scan lists the .bag recordings in the capture folders.

job.title: Finding the best frames
job.pollingHint: Live updates stopped; the app now asks the engine every half second.
job.stopHint: Stop reading the recording and keep the frames found so far
job.noneHint: Open a recording first, then search it for frames.
job.startFailed: The frame search could not start
job.busyElsewhere: The engine is searching another recording, and only one search runs at a time:

candidates.unordered: In recording order, not ranked: differences below the noise floor mean nothing
candidates.stoppedEarlyHint: These are the frames found before it stopped; a complete search may propose others.
candidates.partial: Fewer frames than requested passed the checks
candidates.noneHint: Try another recording, or a part where the whole camel is in view at 1.5 m or more.
candidates.skippedClose: Too close in time to a proposed frame
candidates.title: Proposed frames

session.startDescription: The session measures this frame. The camel ID can be added later, but it is required before finalizing.
session.camelIdHint: Required before finalizing (can be added later)

measure.emptyHint: Choose a kind, click on the frame, then name the measurement.
measure.name: Measurement name
measure.notComputed: The engine computes the value when it is saved.
measure.editingView: Editing view: approval happens on the engine's image
measure.full: This session holds the maximum of 500 measurements
measure.keys: move the crosshair (Shift: 10 px) · Enter places a point (Shift+Enter: a ground point) · Backspace removes the last · Esc cancels · 1–8 kinds · + − 0 zoom
measure.recolorHint: It is drawn in this colour on the canvas, on the engine's image and in the report.

lines.title: Lines of the angle
lines.hint: Pick two distances of the same kind (2D or 3D), on the frame or here.
lines.none: No distance yet: draw two distances first.

hints.none: Choose a measurement kind (keys 1–8). Without a kind, a click selects a measurement; drag a point of the selected one to move it.
hints.readOnly: Read-only: the session is finalized. Reopen it to edit.
hints.distance3d: click the two ends; Shift-click a point on the ground or the background.
hints.curve: click points along the curve; click the last point again (or double-click, or Enter) to finish.
hints.curve3d: click points along the curve; click the last point again (or double-click, or Enter) to finish. Shift-click marks a ground point.
hints.angle3: click the vertex, then one end of each arm.
hints.angle3d: click the vertex, then one end of each arm. Shift-click marks a ground point.
hints.horizontal: click two points: the angle of the line between them from the horizontal.
hints.angle4: pick two distance measurements: the angle between them.

readout.title: Under the cursor
readout.idle: Move over the frame to see the depth the engine finds there.
readout.metadata2d: 2D measurements use Z_ref; this depth is shown for information only.

zref.title: Reference depth and ground
zref.median: median of the camel's valid depth

approval.title: Approve on the engine's image
approval.explain: This is the engine's rendering of the measurements, the same image the PDF will carry. The editing canvas is never used for approval.
approval.mismatch: The image does not match the engine's fingerprint
approval.mismatchExplain: Do not approve it. Download it again; if it still differs, the session's files changed on disk.
approval.imageAlt: The engine's overlay image of the measured frame

report.inputsHint: These are printed exactly as typed. Changing them after printing means printing again.
report.title: Report
report.finalizeFirst: Finalize the session first: the report details come with the report model the engine writes then.
report.modelFailed: The report model could not be loaded
report.modelUnreadable: The report model does not have the expected form
report.stale: This report no longer shows the session
report.staleHint: The session or its report details changed after it was sealed: print it again.
report.pdfFailed: The report could not be downloaded
report.pdfMismatch: The downloaded report does not match the engine's fingerprint
report.notFinalized: This session is not finalized yet
report.approveFirst: Approve the engine's image before printing
report.printExplain: The report is laid out from its details and the approved image and printed to PDF; the engine then attaches the evidence files and seals it. The sealed report appears beside it for sign-off.
report.saveBeforePrint: Save the report details before printing
report.sealedExplain: Every engine check passed: the image pixels, the names in the file's text, the font, the attached evidence files.
report.printWarnings: Some characters printed in a fallback font
report.printWarningsHint: These characters are not in IBM Plex Sans Arabic, so another font drew them. The names the engine checks never print in a fallback font.
report.modelOutdated: This session's report model is older than the print page
report.modelOutdatedHint: Reopen the session and finalize it again: the engine then writes the current report model. Approve the new image, then print.

probe.passExplain: The engine attached the evidence files and sealed the report.
probe.unknown: The check result could not be read
probe.keptAs: The refused file was kept as

pdf.failed: The PDF could not be opened

history.title: Saved sessions
history.search: Search (camel ID, operator, recording, measurement name)
history.actionFailed: The action on the session failed
history.deleteDescription: It moves to the trash and is removed for good at the next start. Changes not saved yet are lost.

admin.title: Data and maintenance
admin.reconciled: Last check of the session folders

design.title: Design system
design.intro: Every token in both themes and both directions. Shown in development builds only.
design.allPass: All pairs meet WCAG AA in both themes.
design.failing: Pairs below the WCAG AA minimum

sample.heading: Camel body measurement
sample.body: The engine measures what the judge draws; the operator names every measurement.

depth.knn: Snapped to the camel (KNN): hollow ring and dotted leader to the neighbours
depth.ground: Shift-click ground target: square (editing canvas only)
depth.jump: Depth jump in a 3D curve segment

design.motion: Hover or focus the box: it moves with the fast, base and slow durations (none when the system asks for reduced motion).
design.icons: Arrows and chevrons point the reading direction; neutral icons never flip.
design.focus: Press Tab: every control shows the focus ring; every target is at least 32 px.
design.componentsIntro: Every primitive in its states, in the theme and direction chosen above. Shown in development builds only.
design.domainIntro: Built from the engine's real payloads (app/fixtures) and the dev data root's session (runs/dev_root): the frame, its mask, the engine's overlay and the sealed PDF, with their fingerprints checked. Shown in development builds only.

demo.deleteDescription: The session moves to the trash and is removed for good at the next start.
demo.editingView: Editing view: this canvas is never used for approval

license.title: Activate Nazeer
license.intro: Paste the licence key you received. It is checked on this computer; no internet connection is needed.
license.storedExpired: The trial has ended. Enter a new key to continue.
license.storedInvalid: The saved licence key is no longer valid. Enter a key to continue.
license.notSaved: The key is valid but could not be saved: it will be asked for again at the next start.
license.notConfigured: This build has no licence public key, so no key can be checked (development: node tools/generate-license.mjs --init).

reasons.malformed: This is not a valid licence key. Check that it was copied completely.
reasons.bad_signature: This key was not issued for Nazeer, or it has been changed.

license.notRequired: No licence needed in this development build

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.description: The open session has changes the engine could not save (it cannot be reached, or a conflict waits for your choice). Opening another session discards them.

conflict.title: The session was changed elsewhere
conflict.description: These were changed both here and elsewhere. Choose which version to keep: nothing is merged without you.

kinds.both_added: added here and elsewhere under the same number
kinds.order: the order changed here and elsewhere

finalize.title: Finalize the session
finalize.explain: Finalizing makes the engine draw the measurements once, as one image: you approve on that image, and it is the image the report carries. The session then becomes read-only (it can be reopened).
finalize.camelIdMissing: Enter the camel ID: it is required to finalize.
finalize.rejectedWarning: Some measurements are rejected: they appear without a value, with their reasons.
finalize.conflict: Resolve the conflict on the measuring screen first
finalize.rendering: The engine is drawing the image…
finalize.noOverlay: The engine's image is missing for this finalized session
